caption:
Which breathing exercise should you use? It may depend on the moment.

Our four breathing exercises weren't all tested in the same kind of moment. Cyclic sighing and box breathing were tried in real moments of everyday worry, and box breathing may suit a pause, like the moment before a hard task. Slow, even breathing has been tried before bed, and belly breathing as a regular practice over a few weeks.

Not sure where to start? Pick the one that feels easiest. If you feel light-headed or tingly, go back to your usual breathing. If you have a heart, lung or blood condition, epilepsy, or are pregnant, check with your doctor before breath holds or deep belly breathing.

Practise each one with our guided breathing Reels on our profile @equal_psychology.

Save this for when you need it.
